what_happened: Dispatch states specs/ and .claude/ are gitignored and absent from a fresh worktree; in this repository (and a surveyed Lean consumer) specs/ is TRACKED, so a batch worktree carries a HEAD-stale specs/ copy and the symlink candidate cannot apply. Design must cover both postures.

guard-destructive-git.sh and validate-task-creation-audit.sh blocked scratch-fixture commands (git add ., git restore, a fixture JSON write) because the hook evaluates the session tree's dirtiness and command text, not the command's target repository; worked around by rewriting the fixture commands. Doubles as evidence for the two-root audit.

Task description spans seven elements; the two-root audit alone is measured at 194 files. Planned the ruling, the D1 verify repair and eight successor task records inside this task instead of forcing Elements 2-7 into two-hour phases.

verify-touched.sh given four source-store paths selected and ran the DEPLOYED .claude/scripts/tests copies, so its green verdict did not exercise the source-store edits until a redeploy; the two directly relevant suites were run from the source store by hand.

Mutation check in scratch copies proved the new suite falsifiable both ways: a verify forced true fails two cases, and the pre-repair ancestry script fails the three-landing sequence with exits 00 01 01, reproducing the defect.
